protocol.boundaries: left inclusive, right exclusive; whole session roles use first event
protocol.catalog: no label-based filtering of unseen items
protocol.evaluation_sampling: all eligible sessions; no query or negative downsampling
protocol.labels: next click, unique carts/orders; future timestamps and indices retained
protocol.prior_exposure: Original data previously used by exploratory retrieval experiments. All learned components in this experiment must be refitted before history_end. This is a newly reserved temporal evaluation, not a claim of never-seen data.
protocol.query_sampling: deterministic session hash; labels never used for inclusion
